title: loading_screen
summary: MSUI implements the same event-raised, readiness-cleared model, explicitly patterned on Benilla (BENILLA_VS_MSUI_LOADING.md): the curtain arms at the Enter World click (ArmEnterWorldCurtain), per-map art resolves through the verified Map.dbc -> LoadingScreens.dbc -> BLP chain with a per-path decode cache, the bar draws the 1.12 two-layer Loading-BarBorder/Loading-BarFill art, progress is monotonic (BumpProgress), and the clear is gated on real residency: terrain ring, warmed+placed WMOs, near doodads drained behind the curtain, collision built under the player, appearance-ready avatar, then a pipeline-warm fade. Cross-map SMSG_NEW_WORLD re-arms the whole cycle via the world-entry transition stages.

openItems.text: SMSG_TRANSFER_PENDING does not raise the cover: the curtain only rises when SMSG_NEW_WORLD lands, so a portal walk-in shows the old (already-unloading) world for the server's transfer gap where the reference covers immediately
